label: Full closure of Stellwagen approach
summary: A full closure removes most whale-strike risk but cuts fishing access by more than a third and adds real steaming time. The biggest livelihood cost of the three options.

label: Dynamic zone around latest sightings
summary: A dynamic zone that follows recent sightings removes almost as much risk as a full closure while keeping most fishing access. One of the efficient options.

label: Seasonal 10 kn speed limit (no closure)
summary: A seasonal speed limit keeps nearly all fishing access and still cuts risk by roughly half. Slower transit adds some time but very little fuel. An efficient option.
